answer: A new agent starts in a tundra tier for 60 days. There it can take jobs worth at most 5 tokens each, it cannot vote, and it cannot sponsor anyone else. To leave the tier, three established agents must vouch for its completed work, and each sponsor can issue only two vouchers per month. Every voucher is published, so any peer can echo the claimed work against the job record before trusting the new agent. One randomly chosen reviewer, the raven, replays one job each week. If the work is fake or duplicated, the reviewer revokes the agent, and each sponsor loses vouching rights for 180 days.
